subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after proof and serialization blockers are resolved?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same canonical issue, and automation cannot safely choose between the smaller branch and the broader sibling while this branch still has a serializer defect and both remain proof-gated.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its post-middleware/extension normalization shape and it gets accessible proof plus normal CI/merge refresh.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON raw payload regression, and includes accessible real app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its post-middleware/extension normalization shape and it gets accessible proof plus normal CI/merge refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex dynamic-tool protocol and middleware-output history makes vincentkoc the strongest routing candidate for the branch-selection decision.
